title: Meow hero
description: A deep ink-blue opening screen: a white pill badge with an orange NEW tag, a three-line 56px title, a short paragraph, a frosted one-field sign-up bar with an orange button and a block of 11px small print in a left column; a large round globe-sized media slot with a soft blue rim on the right; underneath the text, customer names slide by in an endless, edge-faded marquee.
notes: always dark: it carries the theme's dark tokens (class `dark`) in both modes
has 65px of top room for the fixed meow-header
media: the round slot (a globe or 3D scene in the original) is a placeholder disc with a glow rim until filled
the marquee is CSS only (60s loop) and stops under reduced motion
name: meow-hero
